class.name: Axle
class.brief_description: A vehicle axle that groups wheels and controls steering, drive torque, and anti-roll.
class.description: Axle is a [Node3D] that serves as a grouping node for [Wheel] children. It computes suspension parameters per wheel, controls steering via an internal steering rack model, distributes drive torque, and provides anti-roll bar force between paired wheels.

method.name: set_steerable
method.description: If [code]true[/code], the wheels on this axle respond to the vehicle's steering input.

method.name: get_steerable
method.description: Returns whether this axle is steerable.

method.name: set_drive_ratio
method.description: Sets the fraction of engine torque sent to this axle (0.0 to 1.0). Values across all axles should sum to 1.0.

method.name: get_drive_ratio
method.description: Returns the drive torque ratio for this axle.

method.name: set_steering_rack_data
method.description: Sets the [SteeringRackData] resource for configuring the steering rack (gains, inertia, friction).

method.name: set_downforce_ratio
method.description: Sets the fraction of total aerodynamic downforce applied to this axle (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: get_downforce_ratio
method.description: Returns the downforce ratio for this axle.

method.name: get_steer_angle
method.description: Returns the current steering angle in radians applied to the wheels on this axle.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this axle responds to steering input.
Fraction of engine torque applied to this axle (0.0 to 1.0).
Fraction of total aerodynamic downforce applied to this axle (0.0 to 1.0).
[SteeringRackData] resource configuring the steering rack dynamics (gains, inertia, friction, max angle).
[TireData] resource configuring tire parameters for all wheels on this axle. Overrides the vehicle-level tire data if set.
